title: Gemini, the Big-Library Helper
goal: Gemini knows facts and can look at pictures.
mascot_lines: Gemini is Google's helper, and it's special because it can see pictures too.
You can show Gemini a photo and it will tell you what's in it.
Gemini also knows lots of facts and can help with school stuff.
Try the paperclip below to attach a picture, then ask Gemini what it sees.

tier2.rephrase: Gemini is great for facts. Match each helper to its job.

tier3.nudge: Big plan = Claude. Quick edit = Cursor. Fact = Gemini.
